blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte was subpoenaed to testify in the Senate impeachment court not because he’s the brother of Vice President Sara Duterte but because, in his position, he might be able to explain alleged transactions between the city government and the company in which her sister had reportedly declared a financial interest. As House trial spokesperson Zia Alonto Adiong of Lanao del Sur clarified in a statement issued on Sunday: “He is not being called because he is the brother of VP Sara.
